issues.title: 9-3 front hub shared SKU must not be treated as an approved used Opel/Fiat donor
issues.cause: Aftermarket PFI interchange combines multiple marques under a product family.
symptoms: Catalogue associates Saab 9-3 with Vectra/Signum and Croma
Unknown donor wheel-sensor signal, spline geometry and installed Saab part
issues.diagnosis_summary: Read Saab VIN and original hub; obtain OEM approved configuration, dimensioned comparison, ABS signal/connections and installation requirements.
issues.correction_summary: Mark as catalogue candidate only; no ordering or salvage substitution approval.
limits: Donor OE units may vary even if a supplier bundles them under a universal aftermarket part.
Wheel-bearing and ABS faults are safety critical.

issues.title: 9-3 pad catalogue cross risks misfit between factory brake levels
issues.cause: Saab original 9-3 option codes select different front caliper/disc families; 93188111 catalogue row is 15-inch/AA AB.
symptoms: Retailer shows multiple pad families for one model year
Unknown brake disc and caliper code on actual car
issues.diagnosis_summary: Identify plate codes 7 and 9, measure disc/caliper, confirm certified pad part/kit components with current manufacturer catalogue.
issues.correction_summary: Only select the exact proven brake level; never assume an Opel pad fits every 9-3.
limits: Brakes are safety critical; no performance or fitment verification performed.
Even same OE number in a merchant cross does not guarantee option-level vehicle fit.

issues.title: Older B235 PCV aftermarket listing cannot be applied to 2008 9-5
issues.cause: Retailer listing for ProParts 21341200 / Saab 55561200 covers old 1998–2003 9-5 and earlier OG 9-3 in selected diagrams.
symptoms: Both early and later vehicles carry B235-family name
PCV line routing and engine serial revisions may differ
issues.diagnosis_summary: Match exact engine year/serial, hoses, check valves and manufacturer campaigns against current original and later 9-5 EPC diagrams.
issues.correction_summary: Do not order earlier kit for 2008 wagon without actual compatible OE application.
limits: Specific old kit remains a legitimate catalogue lead for older cars.
This source does not support MY2008 B235R fitment.
